i4f_reduced_static_pressure_screen.png.caption: Single-liquid reduced-model pressure-balance screen for polytropic exponent n=1.25, 0.5 s valve stroke and zero minimum valve opening. limitations: Reduced-model output, not CFD or a measured pressure trace. It does not model vapor formation, gas ingestion, cavity dynamics or two-phase pressure recovery; threshold crossings do not establish cavitation.
